plan.text: Captain, aaj sirf tokenization ka axis a — ek hi cheez. Teen padaav: pehle tera apna guess, bina meri madad; phir hum token ko haath se kholenge; phir tera locked weld wapas. Ant mein tere paas ek saaf line — token kya hai, aur tokenization ka kaam kahan khatam hota hai. Shuru karein?

Tu yahan hai: padaav ek, tera Pehle-Guess. Main abhi kuch nahi bataunga. Pehle gut-word bol — knew, shaky, ya guessed? Phir do cheezein: token exactly kya hai, aur tokenization ka kaam kahan jaakar khatam ho jaata hai? 'Abhi yaad nahi' poora legal jawab hai — bas guess ko guess bol dena. Bata, gut-word kya hai?

Tu yahan hai: padaav do, pehla tukda. Ek moti dictionary soch — usme fixed shabd-tukde chhape hain, aur har page pe number. Ye kitaab ek baar chhap gayi, ab badalti nahi; lagbhag ek lakh entries. Token matlab usi kitaab ka ek text-tukda: kabhi ek akshar, kabhi aadha shabd, kabhi pura common shabd. Aur har tukde ke saath ek fixed ID number chipka hai. Bas itna — token koi jaadu nahi, catalog ki ek entry hai.

Tu yahan hai: padaav do, doosra tukda. Ab tokenization ka kaam — sirf do steps. Ek: tera text uthao aur usi chhapi hui kitaab ke known tukdon mein todo. Do: har tukde ka page number, matlab uska ID, line se likh do. Bas. Output ek numbers ki list hai, jaise [4,5]. Na koi matlab, na koi samajh — sirf tukde aur unke numbers.

Tu yahan hai: padaav do, teesra tukda — aur yahi asli daraar hai. Tokenizer ka kaam us ID-list pe KHATAM. Usse aage un IDs ko matlab-wala vector dena, woh embedding hai — bilkul alag, agla stage. Ghar ki soch: raashan ki parchi banana ek kaam, aur dukaan se saamaan uthana doosra kaam. Tokenizer sirf parchi banata hai, saamaan nahi laata.

Tu yahan hai: padaav do ka end, chhota check. Pehle gut-word — knew, shaky, ya guessed? Phir sirf ek option chun: tokenizer ka aakhri output kya hai — (A) numbers ki ID list, ya (B) shabd ka matlab? Gut-word pehle bol?

Token = ek fixed catalog (vocab, ~1 lakh entries) ka text-tukda - letter, subword, ya pura common word. Har token ka ek fixed ID number. Tokenization = text ko un tukdon mein todna + har tukde ka ID nikaalna. Kaam ID-list pe KHATAM (e.g. [4,5]). Un IDs ko meaning-vector dena = embedding (alag, agla stage). Analogy: tokenizer = dictionary jo text ko known shabd-tukdon mein todta aur har ka 'page number' (ID) deta.

Tu yahan hai: aakhri padaav, axis a ka closing. Pehle gut-word — knew, shaky, ya guessed? Phir apne shabdon mein, ek ya do line: token kya hai, aur tokenizer ka kaam kahan khatam hota hai? Meri lines dobara mat bol — jo tere dimaag mein baitha hai wahi bol. Gut-word kya hai?
